title: KBM -  Editor doesn't launch (nothing happens after clicking the button)
author: slt-uxd

status.label: New editor crash is already evidenced
status.detail: Multiple reporters supplied bug-report archives and a workaround that narrows the problem to the new Keyboard Manager editor path.

next_action.label: Reproduce new editor launch crash
next_action.reason: Confirm the crash on a current build and capture the exact WinUI/editor path before drafting a fix.

judgment.rationale: This is no longer blocked on author response. Multiple users attached bug-report ZIPs, one follow-up says the classic editor works, and the available event/log data shows the new Keyboard Manager editor process starting and then crashing with an access violation. The issue is ready for maintainer reproduction on the new editor path.
evidence: The original report says clicking 'Open editor' shows a busy cursor briefly and then nothing happens.
Two later commenters say they see the same issue and attached bug-report ZIPs.
A later follow-up says switching back to the classic editor fixes the problem.
The attached bug-report data shows PowerToys.KeyboardManagerEditor crashing with an access violation in Windows.UI.Xaml.dll after launch.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the crash on the current new-editor path, compare it to the classic editor path, and capture the exact view/state transition that faults.

fix_assessment.rationale: The evidence proves a current new-editor failure, but it does not yet isolate whether the fault is a specific WinUI page/state transition, persisted remap metadata, or a broader launch lifecycle issue.

issue_context.summary: The new Keyboard Manager editor launches and then disappears, while the classic editor path still works for at least one affected user.
known_information: The issue targets PowerToys 0.100.2 from the Microsoft Store.
Multiple users reproduced the failure and attached bug-report archives.
One follow-up says switching back to the classic editor avoids the problem.
The available event viewer data shows an access-violation crash in PowerToys.KeyboardManagerEditor after launch.
inferences: The problem is specific to the new editor path rather than the Keyboard Manager settings entry point in general.
The next engineering question is which loaded page/state transition or persisted editor data causes the crash, not whether the bug exists.
issue_context.analysis: This is ready for maintainer reproduction because the thread already contains bug-report archives and a narrowing workaround. The public evidence is enough to move from 'please send logs' to 'replay the new editor launch path and isolate the crashing UI state'.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue discussion and timeline.
Reviewed one attached bug-report archive's Keyboard Manager editor log, settings, and event-viewer entry.
Inspected Keyboard Manager's launch path in src/modules/KeyboardManager/dll/dllmain.cpp.

reproduce.title: Verify new Keyboard Manager editor launch versus classic editor
reproduce.version_requirement: PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer with the new editor available
prerequisites: New editor path enabled in settings
setup: Open the Keyboard Manager settings page.
steps: Click 'Open editor' with the new editor enabled and watch whether the process appears and then crashes.
Compare the result with the classic editor path on the same machine.
If the new editor crashes, inspect the editor log and event viewer entry for the exact page/state transition before the fault.
reproduce.expected_result: The new editor opens and stays usable just like the classic editor; any crash should be attributable to a concrete post-launch state transition.
